The main European residency
by investment programs
acf.s019_p: Invest for a residence permit or European Golden Visa, or for European citizenship. The 2 most common routes are real estate and investing in or donating to a fund.

the European Golden Visa

acf.s057_p: Naturalization requires at least 7 years of living in Greece
acf.s058_p: You must meet the residence and language conditions set by Greek law
